title: Purple Velvet Cardigan & Ruffled Mini
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight dark hair walks along a flagstone path beside a lawn with dry leaves. She wears a purple velvet cropped V-neck cardigan with gold trim and a small pendant necklace, plus a dark ruffled mini skirt with gold studs. Knee-high purple lace socks and lace-up gray sneakers complete the look. A small backpack hangs from one shoulder. Her expression is calm and direct. Warm autumn sunlight. Palette of violet, charcoal, and gold. Preppy and nostalgic, in the style of a 2000s campus street-style photo.
workingNotes:
- The velvet cardigan and ruffled skirt are the signature pieces.
- Keep the flagstone path for a sense of movement.
